name: Bogatha Waterfall (Niagara of Telangana)

name: Basar Gnana Saraswathi Temple
description: Ancient temple on the banks of the Godavari River, venerated as one of only two prominent temples dedicated to Goddess Saraswathi in India (the other being in Jammu & Kashmir), attributed to Sage Vyasa.

name: Sri Komuravelli Mallikarjuna Swamy Temple

name: Bhadrakali Lake and Temple
description: Situated on the banks of the scenic Bhadrakali Lake between Hanamkonda and Warangal, an ancient temple built in 625 CE by Chalukya King Pulakeshin II dedicated to Goddess Bhadrakali with 8 hands carrying weapons.

name: Warangal Fort
description: Constructed in the 13th century by King Ganapatideva and Queen Rudrama Devi, famous for its triple-ring concentric walls and four monumental ornamental gateways (Kakatiya Kala Thoranam, the emblem of Telangana).

name: Birla Mandir Hyderabad
description: Built in 1976 from 2,000 tons of pure white Rajasthani Makrana marble atop the 280-foot high Naubat Pahad hill, dedicated to Lord Venkateswara, featuring an architectural blend of South Indian, Utkal, and Rajasthani styles.

name: Buddha Statue Hussain Sagar
description: Erected in 1992 on Gibraltar Rock in the center of Hussain Sagar lake, an astounding 58-foot tall monolithic white granite statue of Lord Buddha weighing 350 tons, sculpted by 200 master stonemasons.

name: Charminar
description: Constructed in 1591 by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah to commemorate the eradication of a deadly plague, the global symbol of Hyderabad featuring four 56-meter minarets, stucco arches, and an upper-floor mosque.

name: Chowmahalla Palace
description: The official ceremonial residence of the Nizams of Hyderabad, begun in 1750 by Salabat Jung and completed by Asaf Jah V, featuring four grand palaces, the majestic Khilwat Mubarak durbar hall with 19 Belgian crystal chandeliers, and vintage royal car collections.

name: Golconda Fort

name: Nehru Zoological Park Hyderabad
description: Spanning 380 acres near Mir Alam Tank, one of India's premier and largest zoos, renowned for open-moated enclosures, a dedicated lion and tiger safari, India's first nocturnal animal house, and a toy train.

name: NTR Gardens
description: A 36-acre public leisure and memorial park on the shores of Hussain Sagar lake, dedicated to former Chief Minister N.T. Rama Rao, featuring a monorail ride, Japanese gardens, machan viewpoints, and dancing musical fountains.

name: Qutb Shahi Tombs Hyderabad

name: Rotary Park for Children (Sanjeevaiah Park)

name: Salar Jung Museum Hyderabad
description: Situated on the southern bank of the Musi River, housing the peerless personal collection of Salar Jung III comprising over 40,000 art objects, European oil paintings, Persian carpets, and the famous 19th-century musical clock.

name: Taj Falaknuma Palace
description: Perched on a 2,000-foot hill overlooking Hyderabad, built in 1893 by Nawab Sir Viqar-ul-Umra and purchased by the 6th Nizam, showcasing Italian Carrara marble, Tudor and Italianate architecture, and a 101-seat dining table.

name: Alampur Temples
description: Situated in the Peddawadi gram panchayat of Mahabubnagar district in Telangana, Alampur Temples, a village nestled on the banks of Tungabhadra River, is a treasure trove of rich cultural heritage and architectural brilliance. This sacred site is famous for the intricate rock cut temples of 7th-century Pallava style and is considered one of the 18 Shakti peethas in India, a pilgrimage site for devotees seeking spiritual enlightenment. As one explores the village, the soothing sounds of the river flow, amidst lush green surroundings, provide a serene and meditative atmosphere, making Alampur an ideal destination for those seeking a unique blend of spirituality, nature, and history.

name: Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Located in the Eastern Ghats of Telangana, India, the Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary is a treasure trove of flora and fauna. Spread across 893 square kilometers, this majestic sanctuary is home to over 400 species of plants, 150 species of birds, and 24 species of mammals, including the majestic tiger. With its rugged terrain, rolling hills, and pristine water bodies, Kawal Wildlife Sanctuary is a haven for nature lovers, photographers, and wildlife enthusiasts. The sanctuary offers a unique opportunity to experience the rich cultural heritage of the surrounding tribal communities and immerse in the tranquil ambiance of the dense forest. The sanctuary also features several waterfalls, including the beautiful Gummadi Guvvala waterfalls, which add to its natural charm.

name: Medak Fort

name: Kandlakoya Oxygen Park

name: Laknavaram Lake
description: Nestled within the majestic Satveda Hills, Laknavaram Lake stands as a serene sanctuary in the midst of the dense forests of Telangana. This enchanting mountain getaway offers a tranquil escape from the bustling city life, transporting you to an idyllic realm of breathtaking natural beauty. The crystal-clear waters of the lake, set amidst a lush backdrop of vibrant greenery, provide a serene haven for nature enthusiasts. As you unwind amidst the rustic charms of this enchanting destination, the symphony of chirping birds, rustling leaves, and chirping insects creates an unforgettable experience for the senses. With its enchanting scenery, scenic mountain trails, and diverse wildlife, Laknavaram Lake presents a perfect convergence of nature's splendor and serenity.

name: Ramappa Temple
description: Located in the remote village of Palampet, Ramappa Temple stands as a testament to the rich cultural heritage of Telangana. This ancient temple, dedicated to Lord Shiva, exemplifies the unique architecture of the Kakatiya dynasty, characterized by its intricate carvings and imposing structure. As you step into the temple complex, immerse yourself in the serenity of its surroundings, surrounded by lush green forests and the gentle sounds of nature.

name: Kadam Dam
description: Kadam Dam, also known as the Kadam Narayana Reddy Project, is a major dam located in the Adilabad/Nirmal district of Telangana. Constructed across the Kadam River, a tributary of the Godavari, at the point of their confluence, the dam is a key irrigation project. The reservoir is surrounded by lush green hills, manicured parks, and offering boating facilities, making it a popular weekend getaway.
